# GUIDE manual examples

Batch inputs for the examples in the GUIDE manual (version 46.1) that guide-rs can express. Each `input.txt` was generated by replaying the manual's interactive dialog in the pinned GUIDE 46.3 binary, answering each prompt as the manual does and taking the default for prompts the manual lacks (46.3 asks "basic tree or trees with higher accuracy" where 46.1 asked "default options"). The Poisson examples (sections 9.1 to 9.3) were replayed with non-default options so that GUIDE writes fitted values.

| Directory | Manual section | Data |
|---|---|---|
| `fish-constant` | 4.1 | `fishdsc.txt` |
| `fish-lda` | 4.2 | `fishdsc.txt` |
| `ce-classification` | 5.1 | `ce2021class.dsc` |
| `ce-constant` | 6.1 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `ce-polynomial` | 6.2 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `ce-stepwise` | 6.3 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `ce-quantile` | 7.1 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `ce-quantile-linear` | 7.2 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `ce-two-quantiles` | 7.3 | `ce2021reg.dsc` |
| `nhtsa-polynomial` | 8.1 | `nhtsadsc.txt` |
| `solder-poisson` | 9.1 | `solder.dsc` |
| `solder-poisson-linear` | 9.2 | `solder.dsc` |
| `lungcancer-poisson-offset` | 9.3 | `lungcancer.dsc` |

The data are not stored here. `tools/compare_manual_examples.py` downloads the manual's `datafiles.zip` into the ignored `.reference/manual-data/`, checks its pinned SHA-256 and strips the carriage returns that several of its files contain. Examples for censored, multiresponse, longitudinal, treatment, propensity, DIF and logistic models with an E variable are omitted because guide-rs does not implement them. See [the comparison record](../../../docs/manual-examples.md).
